data.gender_notes: Vigneshwaran is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.

Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: विग्नेश्वरन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of all obstacles, the remover of all obstacles, Vignanam (knowledge) Ishvara (Lord)

in_hindi.name: विग्नेश्वरन
in_hindi.meaning: विग्नानाम् ईश्वर:, विग्नानाम् सब संपरक्षक, विग्नानाम् हर:, Lord of Obstacles
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of all obstacles, the protector of all obstacles, the destroyer of all obstacles, Vignanam (knowledge) Ishvara (Lord)

in_tamil.name: விக்னேஷ்வரன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of all obstacles, Vignanam (knowledge) Anbar (Lord)

in_telugu.name: విగ్నేశ్వరన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of all obstacles, Vignanam (knowledge) Purusha (Lord)

in_marathi.name: Vigneshwaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Vigneshwara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vigneshwaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the power of Vigneshwara (Lord Ganesha)

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Vigneshwara
